 744 [90mÔöé[39m 744 [90mÔöé[39m [90m  spin() {[39m                                                                                                                                                                 
 745 [90mÔöé[39m 745 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    if (this.isSpinning || this.chatters.length === 0) return;[39m                                                                                                             
 746 [90mÔöé[39m 746 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    this.isSpinning = true;[39m                                                                                                                                                
 747 [90mÔöé[39m 747 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    this.spinAngleStart = Math.random() * 10 + 10;[39m                                                                                                                         
 748 [90mÔöé[39m 748 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    this.spinTime = 0;[39m                                                                                                                                                     
 749 [90mÔöé[39m 749 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    this.spinTimeTotal = Math.random() * 3e3 + 4e3;[39m

 752 [90mÔöé[39m 752 [90mÔöé[39m [90m  rotateWheel() {[39m                                                                                                                                                          
 753 [90mÔöé[39m 753 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    this.spinTime += 20;[39m                                                                                                                                                   
 754 [90mÔöé[39m 754 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    if (this.spinTime >= this.spinTimeTotal) {[39m                                                                                                                             
 755 [90mÔöé[39m 755 [90mÔöé[39m [90m      this.stopRotateWheel();[39m                                                                                                                                              
 756 [90mÔöé[39m 756 [90mÔöé[39m [90m      return;[39m                                                                                                                                                              
 757 [90mÔöé[39m 757 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    }[39m                                                                                                                                                                      
 758 [90mÔöé[39m 758 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    const spinAngle = this.spinAngleStart - this.easeOut(this.spinTime, 0, this.spinAngleStart, this.spinTimeTotal);[39m                                                       
 759 [90mÔöé[39m 759 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    this.startAngle += spinAngle * Math.PI / 180;[39m

 763 [90mÔöé[39m 763 [90mÔöé[39m [90m  stopRotateWheel() {[39m

 766 [90mÔöé[39m 766 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    const degrees = this.startAngle * 180 / Math.PI % 360;[39m                                                                                                                 
 767 [90mÔöé[39m 767 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    const arcd = 360 / this.chatters.length;[39m

 769 [90mÔöé[39m 769 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    const winner = this.chatters[index % this.chatters.length];[39m                                                                                                            
 770 [90mÔöé[39m 770 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    this.showWinner(winner);[39m

 772 [90mÔöé[39m 772 [90mÔöé[39m [90m  easeOut(t, b, c, d) {[39m                                                                                                                                                    
 773 [90mÔöé[39m 773 [90mÔöé[39m [90m    const ts = (t /= d) * t;[39m
